user.description: Enter your MitID username to begin authentication.

data_description.mitid_username: The username you use to log in with MitID.

mitid_auth.title: MitID Authentication
mitid_auth.description: Open the MitID app and approve the login request.

mitid_qr.title: Scan QR Code
mitid_qr.description:
Open your MitID app and scan the animated QR code below. Approve the login on your phone, then click **Submit**.

![MitID QR Code]({qr_url})

select_widgets.title: Select Data Providers
select_widgets.description: Select which widget data providers to pull data from. Widgets marked **(not supported)** are not yet implemented and will be ignored.

data_description.widgets: Aula widgets that provide additional data such as library loans, weekplans, and homework.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with MitID
reauth_confirm.description: Your Aula session has expired. Click **Submit** to start re-authentication with MitID for **{mitid_username}**.

reconfigure.description: Token refresh failed. Enter your MitID username to re-authenticate.

data_description.mitid_username: The username you use to log in with MitID.

progress.authenticating: Open the MitID app and approve the login request.

error.auth_failed: MitID authentication failed. Please try again.
error.connection: Unable to connect to Aula. Please check your network.

abort.already_configured: This MitID account is already configured.

auth_failed.message: Authentication with Aula failed. Please re-authenticate.

connection_failed.message: Unable to connect to Aula. Please try again later.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Aula account "{target}" is not loaded. Reload the integration and try again.

exit_with_required.message: The activity type "{activity_type}" requires exit_with to name the person collecting the child.

invalid_target.message: "{target}" is not an Aula child. Target the device for the child you want to update.

invalid_time_range.message: The entry time ({entry_time}) must be before the exit time ({exit_time}).

no_target.message: No Aula child was targeted. Select at least one child device.

no_loaded_account.message: No Aula account is loaded. Check the integration and try again.

ambiguous_account.message: More than one Aula account is configured. Set config_entry_id to choose which one to read.

update_presence.name: Update presence
update_presence.description: Sets the planned drop-off and pick-up times for one or more children.

entry_time.name: Entry time
entry_time.description: Time the child is dropped off.

exit_time.name: Exit time
exit_time.description: Time the child is collected or allowed to leave.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day to update. Defaults to today.

activity_type.name: Activity type
activity_type.description: How the child leaves at the end of the day.

exit_with.name: Collected by
exit_with.description: Name of the person collecting the child, including the relation in parentheses as Aula shows it, for example "Nick Nissen (Far)". Required for "Collected by" and "Goes home with".

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Whether the times repeat on the same weekday.

expires_at.name: Expires at
expires_at.description: When a repeating entry stops. Defaults to the end of the school year.

get_thread_messages.name: Get thread messages
get_thread_messages.description: Returns the full text of the messages in one thread. Thread IDs are listed in the "messages" attribute of the Latest messages sensor.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: How many of the newest messages to return, from 1 to 50.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which Aula account to read. Only needed when more than one is configured.
